description.zh: 要授权的专用入网凭证ID。
description.en: The ID of the dedicated join permission to authorize.

description.zh: 要授权的开发者的阿里云账号ID。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the developer to authorize.

title.zh: 发起专用入网凭证授权工单
title.en: Submit a dedicated join permission authorization order

descriptions.zh: 网络运营者可以通过该接口向开发者（解决方案供应商）授权一个专用入网凭证。不过只是发起了一个授权工单，需待开发者接受该授权后，授权才能完成。
descriptions.en: A network operator can call this operation to authorize a dedicated join permission to a developer (Solutions provider). This operation only initiates an authorization ticket. The authorization is completed only after the developer accepts the authorization.
